name: acc_ops_engage
description: req-vd-ad:REQ-AD-026 step a. Switch ACC on and SET at t=1.0, then hands off the controls entirely (no pedal input for the rest of the run) so the following behaviour that follows is the FUNCTION's, not a human's. Button bit values: ACC_TOGGLE=512, ACC_SET_RESUME=1024 (ButtonBits, control/common/VehicleCommand.hpp). Each press is a PAIR of keyframes -- bit set, then cleared -- because the ADAS controls are edge-triggered (DecodeAdasOperations); a bit left set would be one press, not a held one, but leaving it set would also block every later press of the same button from ever producing an edge. t=1.0 rather than t=0.0 so the controller has settled and the Init SpeedAction has taken (the first frames of a ManualDrive run are before activation).
